title: Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku (Demo)
overview:
There's as much happiness as there are friends.

Sure, we might fight now and then, but in the end the ones you can count on are fun friends you get along with. Even things you can't do alone go well when everyone does them together, right? What matters is how wonderful the relationships you can build are. So come on, let's spend a wonderful time surrounded by lots of friends

In Enfield, a city rebuilt 50 years after a war, you work at a general store run by Arisa, the widow who took you in when she found you lost by the roadside. Wrongly arrested for a crime, you were bailed out at great cost to her. Now you have one year to pay her back, win the trust of the townspeople to earn a new trial, and find out who was really behind it.

Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku is a raising simulation built around friendship. Recruit three companions, choose the odd jobs to take on each week and assign them to your team. On weekends, train your skills or spend time with the people of the town to deepen your bonds.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

仲間の数だけ、HAPPYがある。

そりゃまぁ、たまにはケンカもするだろうけど、結局たよりになるのは、気の合う楽しい仲間だよね。一人じゃできないことも、みんなでやればうまくいくじゃない。大切なのは、どれだけステキな関係が築けるかってこと。さ、大勢の仲間に囲まれて、ステキな時間をすごそうよ
